name: Agama

review.observation: Full original: blunt triangular orange head, blue/grey scaled trunk, about-body-length banded tail and four foot endpoints. Belly is naturally held clear of ground; some dorsal spikes are present. Far roots are occluded and the near hind toes include a long raised digit; grounded contact requires rig review. Broad margins.

decisions.paintingObservation: No paired projecting mammalian pinnae are depicted. Any ear opening, tympanum, protective ear flap, casque, horn, neck frill or external gill remains natural head/neck paint; none is a substitute pinna.

policyStatus: AUDIT_ONLY_CANDIDATE: production reviewed-presence.mjs still admits tail absence only.
